It's not often you come across a game that you could even put in the ballpark of "life-changing," and yet here we are. Super Psycho Baseball transports players to a lawless world with a cast of characters to do battle with - characters like Pitchy, an adorable robot, and Harry the overloader. Hit your balls. Score your home runs. Be taunted by your foes. Sell your soul to the devil. Touch the sky. The sky is the limit in Super Psycho Baseball and we think you're going to love it.

Takes a good amount of practice to master the timings, but a fun time killer. Every level has its own creative character/pitcher with their own funny voicelines. The game gets progressivly harder, you earn coins to purchase powerups and assists. Early Access and the developer is going to continue to add more levels so I am interested in playing those. This is a great game to play anytime. A suggestion for fellow game addicts, if you have a long lobby queue in a video game. Pop open Super Psycho Baseball and play while you wait. When the queue pops, pause and come back later to play more innings. This game doesn't consume a lot of resources so it wont harm performance running in background.

My left click on my mouse is broken and only registers clicks half the time, so I cannot beat Pitchy, the difficulty is high, especially without left click! I have reached out to Logitech (the manufacturer) and Amazon (where I purchased the mouse) and both are passing the blame between each other and Im stuck in limbo here! This is madness and there are games to go to and I cannot because of a faulty mouse! Update as of 17/Feb/2023: Amazon finally caved and issued a replacement mouse (Logitech G502 HERO btw, very good mouse, the buttons feel great, the unlock button for the mouse wheel that allows it to spin freely forever is really amazing and makes awesome general use of the device!) Finally I've given the game a good shot with a working mouse and its tough, but rewarding. But even with a working mouse, I need more training to beat Piney! There's no utility for the mouse wheel in the game however, but if something is added then maybe the G502 HERO by Logitech will give an upper hand!

As much as I would like to recommend the game, the dev seems to have quit the internet for the time being (according to his twitter) and as such the game will likely not receive any more updates. The game has received no updates for 5 months, and even at only $5 there's really not enough content to justify purchasing given there will be no new updates.

At first I despised Pitchy Pitcherson, his sick sense of humor, his low pitches I loathed... but then I learned of his ex-wife. That horrible brute, she broke this man. She berated Pitcherson in every aspect, including his pitches. He became self-conscious and cold to her. That's when she began staying out later with the girls... suspicious of her intentions, he followed her one night, and learned the truth: she was shacking up with PINEY, THAT DESPICABLE TREE. HOW COULD A TREE BE BETTER THAN HIM? He walked home in silence. When she returned early in the morning, he was awake to confront her. She said she couldn't help herself, that Piney's wood was so fine. HOW DARE SHE? Pitchy lost not only his wife, but the three little basebols that they made together, when she won full custody. Now Pitchy Pitcherson pitches alone. Knowing this only now sickens me to my core. I know I can fix him, I just need to win this game.
